Native Define-XML ADQSADAS.AVAL.ACITM01-ACITM14 (QS.QSSTRESN where QSTESTCD=PARAMCD) and ADQSADAS.AVAL.ACTOT, with the PARAMCD codelist and the ACTOT-only ADQSADAS.DTYPE.ACTOT rule, identify the item and total codes and the LOCF total scope. ADQSADAS.DTYPE.CR-10.reason: Native ADQSADAS.DTYPE value-level metadata gives item nulls and the ACTOT LOCF meaning, but SAP pages 10-11 and data guide page-6 leave recipient eligibility and selected-assessment ties incomplete, so the imputation event cannot be reconstructed independently. adadas.r L125-L139 show DTYPE set on created ACTOT records in the reimplementation, which does not supply the missing documented rule.

ADQSADAS.AWRANGE.CR-10.reason: The retained original XML or governing SAP contains the rule, but the prior scalar adapter did not expose the complete value-level/source metadata. This is incomplete checker coverage, not an established documentation defect. Define-XML ADQSADAS.AWRANGE points to the four SAP page-11 intervals, and the finding's own note says the original PDF baseline cell is <=1, so the lost underline is a text-extraction limit, not a missing source, condition or computation. The <=1 string in adadas.r L83-L89 is a later implementation choice and is not evidence of what the SAP states.

Define-XML ADQSADAS.AWLO and SAP page-11 give every finite window start and no finite lower endpoint for Baseline, and storing that nonexistent value as missing is ordinary numeric semantics, not an unstated rule. adadas.r L83-L89 and L142-L147 show the same missing value in the reimplementation but are not documentation.

Define-XML ADQSADAS.AWHI and SAP page-11 give the finite window ends, with Baseline ending at day 1 and no finite end for Week 24, so a missing Week 24 value is the ordinary encoding of an open endpoint. adadas.r L83-L89 and L142-L147 show the reimplementation using the same encoding and do not serve as documentation.

ADQSADAS.QSSEQ.CR-10.reason: Original retained Define-XML value-level rules are present. Keep the original check in the audit, not as a second finding.

ADQSADAS:ABLFL:predecessor_copy.title: Baseline-flag predecessor rule does not state its scope for LOCF recipients
ADQSADAS:ABLFL:predecessor_copy.reason: The unqualified predecessor comparison differs for 57 postbaseline LOCF records whose sequence identifies a baseline donor. Clarify how the baseline-flag source applies to generated recipients; the donor flag alone does not establish recipient baseline status.
